items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口的实现可以通过其 SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() 方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通 FactoryBean 实现，如果其isSingleton() 实现返回 false，则假定总是返回独立实例。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() method or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充后、初始化回调（如 InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() 方法）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: The default behavior is to look up the JNDI object on startup and cache it. This can be customized through the "lookupOnStartup" and "cache" properties, using a JndiObjectTargetSource underneath. Note that you need to specify a "proxyInterface" in such a scenario, since the actual JNDI object type is not known in advance.
items.translation: 默认行为是在启动时查找 JNDI 对象并将其缓存。可以通过 `lookupOnStartup` 和 `cache` 属性进行自定义，底层使用一个 `JndiObjectTargetSource`。请注意，在这种情况下需要指定一个 `"proxyInterface"`，因为实际的 JNDI 对象类型无法预先确定。

items.source: Note that switching to, for example, DriverManagerDataSource is just a matter of configuration: Simply replace the definition of this FactoryBean with a DriverManagerDataSource definition!
items.translation: 请注意，切换到例如 DriverManagerDataSource 只需进行配置：只需将此 FactoryBean 的定义替换为 DriverManagerDataSource 定义即可！

items.source: Note: This is only supported for lookup on startup. If specified together with JndiObjectLocator.setExpectedType(Class), the specified value needs to be either of that type or convertible to it.
items.translation: 注意：此功能仅支持在启动时进行查找。 如果与JndiObjectLocator.setExpectedType(Class)一起指定，则指定的值必须是该类型或可转换为该类型的值。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后，但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source:
The typical usage will be to register this as singleton factory
(for example, for a certain JNDI-bound DataSource) in an application context,
and give bean references to application services that need it.
items.translation: 典型用法是在应用程序上下文中将此注册为单例工厂（例如，针对某个 JNDI 绑定的 DataSource），并向需要它的应用服务提供 Bean 引用。

items.source:
Of course, bean classes in a Spring environment may look up, for example, a DataSource
from JNDI themselves. This class simply enables central configuration of the
JNDI name, and easy switching to non-JNDI alternatives. The latter is
particularly convenient for test setups, reuse in standalone clients, etc.
items.translation: 当然，Spring 环境中的 Bean 类可以自行从 JNDI 中查找 DataSource。该类仅用于集中配置 JNDI 名称，并轻松切换到非 JNDI 替代方案。后者对于测试设置、在独立客户端中复用等场景尤为方便。

items.source:
Typically used in conjunction with "lookupOnStartup"=false and/or "cache"=false.
Needs to be specified because the actual JNDI object type is not known
in advance in case of a lazy lookup.
items.translation: 通常与 "lookupOnStartup"=false 和/或 "cache"=false 配合使用。由于在懒加载查找的情况下无法预先知道实际的 JNDI 对象类型，因此必须指定该属性。

items.source:
Typically used in conjunction with "lookupOnStartup"=false and/or "cache"=false.
Note that proxy interfaces will be autodetected from a specified "expectedType",
if necessary.
items.translation: 通常与 "lookupOnStartup"=false 和/或 "cache"=false 配合使用。请注意，如果必要，代理接口将从指定的 "expectedType" 中自动检测。

items.source:
Can be turned off to allow for late availability of the JNDI object.
In this case, the JNDI object will be fetched on first access.
items.translation: 可关闭以允许 JNDI 对象延迟加载。在这种情况下，JNDI 对象将在首次访问时获取。

items.source: For a lazy lookup, a proxy interface needs to be specified.
items.translation: 对于懒加载查找，需要指定一个代理接口。

items.source:
Can be turned off to allow for hot redeployment of JNDI objects.
In this case, the JNDI object will be fetched for each invocation.
items.translation: 可关闭以允许热重新部署 JNDI 对象。在这种情况下，每次调用时都会获取 JNDI 对象。

items.source: For hot redeployment, a proxy interface needs to be specified.
items.translation: 对于热重新部署，需要指定一个代理接口。

items.source:
Default is "false", i.e. to only expose the JNDI context for object lookup.
Switch this flag to "true" in order to expose the JNDI environment (including
the authorization context) for each method invocation, as needed by WebLogic
for JNDI-obtained factories (for example, JDBC DataSource, JMS ConnectionFactory)
with authorization requirements.
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"，即仅暴露用于对象查找的 JNDI 上下文。将此标志切换为 "true"，以便在每次方法调用时暴露 JNDI 环境（包括授权上下文），这对于 WebLogic 中需要授权的通过 JNDI 获取的工厂（例如，具有授权要求的 JDBC DataSource、JMS ConnectionFactory）是必需的。

items.source:
This can be an arbitrary bean reference or literal value.
It is typically used for literal values in scenarios where the JNDI environment
might define specific config settings but those are not required to be present.
items.translation: 这可以是一个任意的 Bean 引用或字面值。它通常用于以下场景：JNDI 环境可能定义了特定的配置设置，但这些设置并非必须存在。

items.translation: 默认实现会为给定的接口构建一个 JDK 代理类。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: NOTE: Autowiring will simply ignore FactoryBeans that return null here. Therefore, it is highly recommended to implement this method properly, using the current state of the FactoryBean.
items.translation: 注意： 自动装配将简单地忽略在此处返回`null`的 FactoryBean。因此，强烈建议使用 FactoryBean 的当前状态正确实现此方法。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source: This method can be called before this FactoryBean has been fully initialized. It must not rely on state created during initialization; of course, it can still use such state if available.
items.translation: 此方法可以在该 FactoryBean 完全初始化之前被调用。它不能依赖在初始化期间创建的状态；当然，如果可用，它仍然可以使用此类状态。

items.source:
This allows one to check for specific types of beans without
instantiating objects, for example on autowiring.
items.translation: 这允许在例如自动装配时，无需实例化对象即可检查特定类型的 Bean。

items.source:
In the case of implementations that create a singleton object,
this method should try to avoid singleton creation as far as possible;
it should rather estimate the type in advance.
For prototypes, returning a meaningful type here is advisable too.
items.translation: 对于创建单例对象的实现，此方法应尽可能避免创建单例；相反，它应预先估算类型。对于原型对象，在此处返回有意义的类型也是可取的。

items.source:
The singleton status of the FactoryBean itself will generally
be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be
defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。

items.source: Callback that supplies the bean class loader to a bean instance.
items.translation: 向 Bean 实例提供 类加载器 的回调。

items.source: Return the type of object that this FactoryBean creates, or null if not known in advance.
items.translation: 返回此 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如果无法预先确定则返回 `null`。

items.source:
Create a composite interface Class for the given interfaces,
implementing the given interfaces in one single Class.
items.translation: 为给定的接口创建一个组合接口类，在单个类中实现这些接口。

items.translation: 向 Bean 实例提供其所属工厂的回调。

items.translation: 指定一个默认对象，如果 JNDI 查找失败则回退到该对象。

items.translation: 设置是否向访问目标对象的所有请求暴露 JNDI 环境上下文，即。

items.translation: 设置是否在启动时查找 JNDI 对象。

items.translation: 指定用于 JNDI 对象的代理接口。

items.translation: 指定用于 JNDI 对象的多个代理接口。

items.translation: beanFactory - 拥有该 Bean 的 BeanFactory（永远不会为 null）。 该 Bean 可以立即调用工厂上的方法。

items.translation: classLoader - 拥有者类加载器
